sample_method: sorted paths then seeded random sample without replacement
source_disjointness_rule: All listed excluded ACN source sessions were removed before sampling.
geographic_scope: ACN US workplace sites; GridFlex locations are synthetic
session_alignment: Start times are rounded down to a quarter hour. End times retain only complete 15-minute blocks within the ACN-derived connection duration.
energy_feasibility_rule: maximum_kwh and required_kwh never exceed rated power multiplied by the aligned connection duration

source_samples\\acn_session_summaries.cs.classification: COMPUTED summary of REAL/PUBLIC ACN data

behavior\\ev_historical_response.csv.classification: SYNTHETIC, calibrated from linked ACN session

limitations: ACN observations are US workplace charging sessions, not Indian residential EV data.
One sampled ACN session anchors each virtual EV; it is not a persistent real vehicle identity.
Overrides, failures, battery capacity, SOC, and repeated history are synthetic.
Partial connection time below one complete 15-minute block is not represented.
